variables.input:
metrics
| filter metric.key == "custom.proxmox.cluster.nodes.total"
| filter isNotNull(cluster_name)
| fields cluster_name
| dedup cluster_name

metrics
| filter metric.key == "custom.proxmox.node.cpu.usage"
| filter isNotNull(node_name)
| fields node_name
| dedup node_name

hdr_overview.content:
# 🖥️ Proxmox VE — Cluster Overview
Cluster: **$cluster_name** | Use the dropdowns above to filter by node.

tile_node_services.title: Node Service Status (1=active)

tile_node_subscription.title: Node Subscription Active (1=yes)

tile_node_updates.title: Pending Updates per Node

tile_node_tasks.title: Node Tasks (Running / Errors)

tile_node_cpu_info.title: Node CPU / Socket Count
tile_node_cpu_info.query:
timeseries {
  cpus    = avg(`custom.proxmox.node.cpu.count`),
  sockets = avg(`custom.proxmox.node.cpu.sockets`)
}, by: {node_name, cluster_name}, from: now()-5m
| filter cluster_name == $cluster_name
| filter isNull(array($node_name)[0]) or in(node_name, array($node_name))
| fields node_name, cpus = arrayLast(cpus), sockets = arrayLast(sockets)

tile_node_uptime.title: Node Uptime (seconds)

tile_node_cpu.title: Node CPU Usage (%)

tile_node_iowait.title: Node CPU iowait (%)

tile_node_loadavg.title: Node Load Average

tile_node_memory.title: Node Memory (Used / Free / Total)

tile_node_memory_avail.title: Node Memory Available (incl. cache)

tile_node_swap.title: Node Swap (Used / Free / Total)

tile_node_zfs_arcsize.title: Node ZFS ARC Cache Size

tile_node_ksm.title: Node KSM Shared Memory

tile_node_disk.title: Node Root Disk (Used / Avail / Total)

tile_node_network.title: Node Network In / Out

tile_node_netstat.title: Node Tap Network per VM (In / Out)

tile_node_pressure.title: Node Linux PSI Pressure (%)

tile_disk_smart.title: Physical Disk SMART Health (1=PASSED, 0=FAILED)

tile_disk_smart_attrs.title: SMART Attributes (Reallocated Sectors, Pending, CRC Errors…)

tile_disk_size.title: Physical Disk Sizes
tile_disk_size.query:
timeseries max(`custom.proxmox.node.disk.device.size`), by: {disk_dev, node_name, cluster_name}, from: now()-5m
| filter cluster_name == $cluster_name
| filter isNull(array($node_name)[0]) or in(node_name, array($node_name))
| fields disk_dev, node_name, size_bytes = arrayLast(`max(custom.proxmox.node.disk.device.size)`)

tile_vm_status.title: VM Status (1=running, 0=stopped)

tile_vm_cpu.title: VM CPU Usage (%)

tile_vm_memory.title: VM Memory Used vs Total

tile_vm_host_memory.title: VM Host Memory (balloon view)

tile_vm_balloon.title: VM Balloon Memory

tile_vm_disk.title: VM Disk Read / Write

tile_vm_disk_used.title: VM Disk Used (actual bytes)

tile_vm_network.title: VM Network In / Out

tile_vm_snapshots.title: VM Snapshot Count

tile_vm_pressure.title: VM Linux PSI Pressure (%)

tile_vm_config_table.title: VM Configured Limits (cores, memory, CPU priority)
tile_vm_config_table.query:
timeseries {
  cores    = avg(`custom.proxmox.vm.config.cores`),
  sockets  = avg(`custom.proxmox.vm.config.sockets`),
  mem_mib  = avg(`custom.proxmox.vm.config.memory_mib`),
  balloon  = avg(`custom.proxmox.vm.config.balloon_mib`),
  cpulimit = avg(`custom.proxmox.vm.config.cpulimit`),
  cpuunits = avg(`custom.proxmox.vm.config.cpuunits`),
  onboot   = avg(`custom.proxmox.vm.config.onboot`)
}, by: {vm_name, node_name, cluster_name}, from: now()-5m
| filter cluster_name == $cluster_name
| filter isNull(array($node_name)[0]) or in(node_name, array($node_name))
| fields vm_name, node_name,
         cores       = arrayLast(cores),
         sockets     = arrayLast(sockets),
         memory_mib  = arrayLast(mem_mib),
         balloon_mib = arrayLast(balloon),
         cpu_limit   = arrayLast(cpulimit),
         cpu_units   = arrayLast(cpuunits),
         on_boot     = arrayLast(onboot)

tile_vm_snapshot_table.title: VM Status Snapshot
tile_vm_snapshot_table.query:
timeseries {
  status = min(`custom.proxmox.vm.status`),
  cpu    = avg(`custom.proxmox.vm.cpu.usage`),
  vcpus  = avg(`custom.proxmox.vm.cpu.count`),
  mem    = avg(`custom.proxmox.vm.memory.used`),
  maxmem = avg(`custom.proxmox.vm.memory.total`),
  disk   = max(`custom.proxmox.vm.disk.size`),
  netin  = avg(`custom.proxmox.vm.network.in`),
  netout = avg(`custom.proxmox.vm.network.out`),
  uptime = max(`custom.proxmox.vm.uptime`),
  snaps  = max(`custom.proxmox.vm.snapshot.count`)
}, by: {vm_name, node_name, cluster_name}, from: now()-5m
| filter cluster_name == $cluster_name
| filter isNull(array($node_name)[0]) or in(node_name, array($node_name))
| fields vm_name, node_name,
         running    = arrayLast(status),
         cpu_pct    = arrayLast(cpu),
         vcpus      = arrayLast(vcpus),
         mem_used   = arrayLast(mem),
         mem_total  = arrayLast(maxmem),
         disk_size  = arrayLast(disk),
         net_in     = arrayLast(netin),
         net_out    = arrayLast(netout),
         uptime_sec = arrayLast(uptime),
         snapshots  = arrayLast(snaps)

hdr_agent.content:
---
## 🔬 VM Guest Agent Metrics
*Requires `qemu-guest-agent` installed and running inside the VM.*

tile_agent_disk.title: In-Guest Filesystem Usage (Used / Total)

tile_agent_net_bytes.title: In-Guest NIC RX / TX Bytes

tile_agent_net_errors.title: In-Guest NIC Errors / Dropped

tile_agent_disk_table.title: In-Guest Filesystem Table
tile_agent_disk_table.query:
timeseries {
  used  = max(`custom.proxmox.vm.agent.disk.used`),
  total = max(`custom.proxmox.vm.agent.disk.total`)
}, by: {vm_name, mountpoint, node_name, cluster_name}, from: now()-5m
| filter cluster_name == $cluster_name
| filter isNull(array($node_name)[0]) or in(node_name, array($node_name))
| fields vm_name, mountpoint, node_name,
         used_bytes  = arrayLast(used),
         total_bytes = arrayLast(total),
         used_pct    = (arrayLast(used) / arrayLast(total)) * 100

tile_lxc_cpu.title: LXC CPU Usage (%)

tile_lxc_memory.title: LXC Memory Used vs Total

tile_lxc_host_memory.title: LXC Host Memory Used

tile_lxc_swap.title: LXC Swap Used vs Total

tile_lxc_disk_used.title: LXC Disk Used (actual bytes)

tile_lxc_network.title: LXC Network In / Out

tile_lxc_snapshots.title: LXC Snapshot Count

tile_lxc_pressure.title: LXC Linux PSI Pressure (%)

tile_lxc_config_table.title: LXC Configured Limits (cores, memory, CPU priority)
tile_lxc_config_table.query:
timeseries {
  cores        = avg(`custom.proxmox.lxc.config.cores`),
  mem_mib      = avg(`custom.proxmox.lxc.config.memory_mib`),
  swap_mib     = avg(`custom.proxmox.lxc.config.swap_mib`),
  cpulimit     = avg(`custom.proxmox.lxc.config.cpulimit`),
  cpuunits     = avg(`custom.proxmox.lxc.config.cpuunits`),
  onboot       = avg(`custom.proxmox.lxc.config.onboot`),
  unprivileged = avg(`custom.proxmox.lxc.config.unprivileged`)
}, by: {lxc_name, node_name, cluster_name}, from: now()-5m
| filter cluster_name == $cluster_name
| filter isNull(array($node_name)[0]) or in(node_name, array($node_name))
| fields lxc_name, node_name,
         cores        = arrayLast(cores),
         memory_mib   = arrayLast(mem_mib),
         swap_mib     = arrayLast(swap_mib),
         cpu_limit    = arrayLast(cpulimit),
         cpu_units    = arrayLast(cpuunits),
         on_boot      = arrayLast(onboot),
         unprivileged = arrayLast(unprivileged)

tile_lxc_snapshot_table.title: LXC Status Snapshot
tile_lxc_snapshot_table.query:
timeseries {
  status = min(`custom.proxmox.lxc.status`),
  cpu    = avg(`custom.proxmox.lxc.cpu.usage`),
  vcpus  = avg(`custom.proxmox.lxc.cpu.count`),
  mem    = avg(`custom.proxmox.lxc.memory.used`),
  maxmem = avg(`custom.proxmox.lxc.memory.total`),
  swap   = avg(`custom.proxmox.lxc.swap.used`),
  disk   = max(`custom.proxmox.lxc.disk.size`),
  netin  = avg(`custom.proxmox.lxc.network.in`),
  netout = avg(`custom.proxmox.lxc.network.out`),
  snaps  = max(`custom.proxmox.lxc.snapshot.count`)
}, by: {lxc_name, node_name, cluster_name}, from: now()-5m
| filter cluster_name == $cluster_name
| filter isNull(array($node_name)[0]) or in(node_name, array($node_name))
| fields lxc_name, node_name,
         running   = arrayLast(status),
         cpu_pct   = arrayLast(cpu),
         vcpus     = arrayLast(vcpus),
         mem_used  = arrayLast(mem),
         mem_total = arrayLast(maxmem),
         swap_used = arrayLast(swap),
         disk_size = arrayLast(disk),
         net_in    = arrayLast(netin),
         net_out   = arrayLast(netout),
         snapshots = arrayLast(snaps)

tile_storage_chart.title: Storage Used Over Time

tile_storage_avail.title: Storage Available Over Time

tile_storage_table.title: Storage Snapshot Table
tile_storage_table.query:
timeseries {
  used    = max(`custom.proxmox.storage.used`),
  total   = max(`custom.proxmox.storage.total`),
  avail   = max(`custom.proxmox.storage.avail`),
  enabled = min(`custom.proxmox.storage.enabled`),
  active  = min(`custom.proxmox.storage.active`),
  backups = max(`custom.proxmox.storage.backup_count`)
}, by: {storage_name, node_name, cluster_name}, from: now()-5m
| filter cluster_name == $cluster_name
| filter isNull(array($node_name)[0]) or in(node_name, array($node_name))
| fields storage_name, node_name,
         used_bytes      = arrayLast(used),
         total_bytes     = arrayLast(total),
         avail_bytes     = arrayLast(avail),
         utilization_pct = (arrayLast(used) / arrayLast(total)) * 100,
         enabled         = arrayLast(enabled),
         active          = arrayLast(active),
         backup_count    = arrayLast(backups)

tile_replication.title: Replication Jobs — Fail Count & Errors

tile_ceph_osds.title: Ceph OSDs (Total / Up / In)

tile_ceph_bytes.title: Ceph Capacity (Used / Avail / Total)

tile_ceph_io.title: Ceph I/O Throughput

tile_ceph_flags.title: Ceph Operational Flags (1=set — investigate!)
tile_ceph_flags.query:
timeseries max(`custom.proxmox.ceph.flag`), by: {ceph_flag, cluster_name}
| filter cluster_name == $cluster_name
